div.div: تَعَادٍ Uneven places, (K, TA,) dissimilar in their several parts: occurring in this sense in a trad. (TA.) As mentions the saying نِمْتُ عَلَى ↓ مَكَانٍ مُتَعَادٍ , meaning [I slept upon] a place dissimilar in its several parts; uneven: and هٰذِهِ ↓ أَرْضٌ مُتَعَادِيَةٌ This is land having in it burrows, and [trenches, or channels, such as are termed] لَخَاقِيق. (S, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
